notice: Illustrative workflow-state projections only. These are not valid disposition artifacts, author approvals, proposal manifests, receipts, Core records or evidence of actual project progress. Full immutable disposition field bindings remain in docs/workflow-contract.md. No fake digests or recording timestamps are supplied.

scenarios.before: Verified previous non-author disposition; same stable packet, claim and relevant context
scenarios.main_agent_effect: Reuse existing no_update, defer or reject decision without changing its meaning or creating a duplicate disposition.
scenarios.forbidden: Treat recommendation as a new no_update decision replacing a previous defer or reject.

scenarios.before: Verified author disposition and successful receipt for the same authored claim
scenarios.main_agent_effect: Reuse original immutable bundle and receipt. Retain a resubmitted reformatted summary separately if needed.
scenarios.forbidden: New hashes cause duplicate records, or new bytes replace the old approved summary.

scenarios.before: Author disposition exists; no verifiable successful receipt
scenarios.main_agent_effect: Reconcile ownership, all intended actions, baseline/configuration/payload bindings, journal and validation. Resume unchanged approval only if safe; changed proposal needs new exact approval. Missing/inconsistent artifacts stop automated publication.
scenarios.forbidden: Infer success, allocate replacement milestones, or rewrite old approval to match different bytes.

scenarios.before: Earlier defer or reject; substantive new evidence or relevant context and explicit reconsideration
scenarios.recommendation: Fresh bounded assessment; identify the prior disposition
scenarios.main_agent_effect: If reconsidering, append a new immutable disposition linked with supersedes; retain earlier decision, evidence, proposal and receipt. An author decision needs an exact newly prepared validated proposal.
scenarios.forbidden: Promote automatically because a hash changed, or silently edit the old decision.

scenarios.before: Supporting packets already accepted and recorded subordinately
scenarios.recommendation: MILESTONE_CANDIDATE / aggregate_new_claim for newly accepted integrated capability
scenarios.main_agent_effect: Assess a new stable aggregate packet listing prior contributing IDs/dispositions. Approve at most the supported combined milestone and its exact companions; reuse existing events, with justified later attachment if needed.
scenarios.forbidden: Reject the new aggregate solely because constituents were already dispositioned, or duplicate supporting events.
